title: Riot Squad Cherry Fizzle Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pucker up for an iconic e-liquid from Riot Squad. Sugary sweet with a sublime sour streak, this juice boasts rich, bold Cherry balanced with an invigorating sherbet tang. This convenient 50ml nicotine-free shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits .
